title: The Sunless Citadel
description: A search for missing adventurers leads into a buried fortress where kobold and goblin factions compete for control, and an ancient druid tends the sinister Gulthias Tree.
note: April 2020 source files provide an early clue. The exact play dates are unknown. Recent Sunless Citadel material belongs to a different campaign. The gallery includes two published D&D Beyond maps and seven illustrations from the original 2000 module. These are chapter references, not Team Biscuit session captures; illustration credit and source link appear with each item.
artCredit: Adventure cover and official module maps © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference artwork via D&D Beyond.

title: The Forge of Fury
description: An old map points to Khundrukar, the ruined stronghold of the dwarf smith Durgeddin the Black. Its monster-held depths conceal the legendary blades Durgeddin forged.
note: Source files dated May and June 2020 suggest the preparation period, not a confirmed session calendar. The gallery includes two published D&D Beyond maps and seven images from the original 2000 module, separate from Team Biscuit session captures. Credits and source links appear with each image.
artCredit: Adventure cover and official module maps © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference artwork via D&D Beyond.

title: The Speaker in Dreams
description: During Brindinford’s annual street fair, a sudden attack reveals a hidden campaign to seize control of the town. The heroes must uncover the force behind the unrest before the city falls.
note: The archive includes summer 2020 scenes and later Brindinford work. A return visit is possible; its exact story placement remains uncertain.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: The Standing Stone
description: In the isolated village of Ossington, a ghostly rider, hostile elves, and ancient standing stones point to a mystery built on misdirection and a threat to the villagers.
note: The working files cluster around August and September 2020. Preparation and cleanup can fall outside the actual game dates.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Heart of Nightfang Spire
description: Rumors of a dragon’s hoard draw the party to Nightfang Spire, an ancient temple turned tomb. There, vampire Gulthias prepares the undead cult of Ashardalon for the dragon’s return.
note: Original Nightfang work dates to late 2020. The folder later became a catch-all; later files are not assigned here just because of their location.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Deep Horizon
description: Earthquakes and strange sightings lead below the surface to the lost realm of the desmodus, a subterranean people threatened by beholders and salamanders.
note: Local production work clusters from January through June 2021, particularly in May.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Lord of the Iron Fortress
description: On the plane of Acheron, Imperagon is reforging the Blade of Fiery Might with the imprisoned spirits of legendary smiths. The heroes must confront the ruler of the Iron Fortress before he can turn the weapon toward conquest.
note: Varachus mission material is dated September 2021; related work continues into early 2022.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: White Plume Mountain
description: A cryptic challenge sends the heroes into a trap-filled volcanic dungeon to recover three stolen sentient weapons: Blackrazor, Wave, and Whelm.
note: Adventure order is confirmed. Selected White Plume references have 2024 upload dates, which do not establish when the adventure was played.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
description: Icewind Dale is trapped in a winter without sunrise. The heroes face the brutal wilderness, unravel the secrets threatening Ten-Towns, and confront the Frostmaiden’s endless night.
note: Pengu belongs to Frostmaiden, as confirmed by Boss. Much of the surviving material is dated 2024; those are file dates, not confirmed play dates.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Bastion of Broken Souls
description: A deadly attack opens a planar mystery: Ashardalon is feeding on unborn souls to sustain his power. The heroes travel to the Bastion of Unborn Souls to stop the dragon and repair the cycle of life.
note: Preparation files begin in 2022, with published scenes from 2023 onward. The adventure was played after Icewind Dale; production dates do not override that order.
artCredit: Original adventure cover © Wizards of the Coast / TSR. Reference image via Wikipedia.

title: Fungal Bloom
description: A side quest for the alter-ego party, Team Gravy. The archive confirms the adventure title but does not preserve enough plot detail for a fuller, verified synopsis.
note: Boss confirms the adventure and Team Gravy. The possible December 2025 fungal asset set is still unconfirmed, so its selected image lives in Between Adventures.
artCredit: Decorative chapter illustration; not a published module cover.

title: Those Who Writhe Below
tagline: A familiar presence beneath the surface
description: An underwater aboleth lair, its traps, and its fanatical servants form the heart of this subterranean side trek. The creature later returns in the campaign as Brother Xanthar.
note: June 10, 2024 is a working-file clue, not a confirmed session date. The exact placement remains open. No selected media is confidently assigned to this chapter yet.
artCredit: Adventure artwork © its creators. Reference image from the DMDave listing on Roll20.

title: Between Adventures
tagline: Some memories refuse a neat label
description: Selected campaign images and films whose place in the adventure sequence remains unconfirmed.
note: Unassigned, conflicting, or provisional chapter matches are gathered here without guessing their story placement. File dates remain visible on each memory.
